label: Listening 1 — A new member at the sports club
lines: Listening one. A new member at the sports club. Listen and complete.
Hello! Welcome to the sports club. What's your name?
T. H. O. M. P. S. O. N.
Thanks. How old are you, Oliver?
OK. Can I have your phone number?
Sure. It's oh seven eight, three double six, nine one four.
It's on the fourth of July.
Great. See you on Monday, then!

label: Listening 2 — A birthday photo
lines: Listening two. Two friends look at a photo. True or false?
Daniel, is this a photo from your birthday?
Yes, it is. Look, this is my cousin Pablo. He's from Spain.
And who's the man with the camera?
That's my uncle. He's Pablo's dad.
And this lady with the dog?
That's my grandmother, and the dog is hers. He's called Rocky.

label: Listening 3 — A school day
lines: Listening three. Emma talks about her school day. Circle the right answer.
I get up at quarter past seven, and school starts at half past eight.
My first lesson is maths. After that I've got English.
Lunch is at half past twelve.
On Wednesday I go swimming after school.
Friday is my favourite day, because we've got art and music!
